picture-pairs.name: Okugatta ebifaananyi
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Omuzannyo gw'Okugatta Ebifaananyi eri Abantu Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira: Okugatta Ebifaananyi
picture-pairs.description: Omuzannyo ogw'okugatta ebifaananyi ogwa bwereere era omukkakkamu eri abantu ababeera n'obulwadde bw'okwerabira. Ebifaananyi ebinene bisigala nga birabika, tewali ssaawa oba bubonero, era olonda obutundu 4 okutuuka ku 12.
picture-pairs.short: Zuula ebifaananyi ebibiri ebifaanagana. Ebifaananyi biyinza okusigala nga birabika.
picture-pairs.players: Omuntu 1 oba 2, nga batudde ku lusegere
picture-pairs.intro: Koonya ku kifaananyi, oluvannyuma okoonye ku ekikifaanagana. Ebifaananyi bisigala nga birabika okuva ku ntandikwa, kale tewali kyetaagisa kujjukira. Ebifaananyi ebibiri bwe bigendera wamu biba n'olukoloboze lwa zaabu n'akabonero akalaga nti kituufu.
howTo: Londa obutundu bungi bw'oyagala okukozesa. Obutundu buna butandikirwako bulungi era mu bukkakkamu.
Koonya ku kifaananyi kyonna. Kiba n'olukoloboze lwa zaabu.
Koonya ku kifaananyi ekifaanagana nakyo. Ekibiri ekyo kisigala wamu n'akabonero akalaga nti kituufu.
Ebifaananyi ebibiri bwe biba tebifaanagana, tewali kibi kibaawo. Ddamu okoonye buli lwe mwetegeka.
Teekako "Ebifaananyi ebikwekeddwa" bw'aba mmwe mwembi munyumirwa engeri ey'edda ey'ebifaananyi ebikyusiddwa.
tips: Mwogerere ku bifaananyi wamu mu ddoboozi eriwulikika era mwogereko: "Ekikopo ky'ecaayi ekimyufu. Onywa caayi n'amata?"
Leka omuntu gw'olabirira y'akoonye, ne bw'akitwala akaseera. Mulage n'engalo okusinga okumukoonyera.
Sigala n'obutundu buna okumala ebbanga lyonna lye kiwulira nga kirungi. Obutundu obungi kiri ku lulonda, si ddaala lye muteekwa okutuukako.
Mumalirize nga mukyanyumirwa. Omuzannyo gumu guba omulimu ogujjuvu.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa, bubonero, kubala ntambula oba kuwangulwa. Osobola okuyimirira ekiseera kyonna, era okuyimirira wakati kiba ngeri nnungi ey'okumaliriza.

Okusigaza ebifaananyi nga birabika kifuula omuzannyo okuba ogw'okutunuulira n'okugatta so si ogw'okujjukira. Abantu bangi kino bakisanga nga kikkakkanya. Osobola okukyusa ogende ku bifaananyi ebikwekeddwa mu kukoonya lumu bw'oba oyagala.

faq.q: Gwa bwereere, era nneetaaga okuwandiika erinnya lyange?
faq.a: Yee, gwa bwereere, era tewali akawunti, kuwandiika linnya oba kuwanuula. Gukolera mu bulawuzi y'omukutu ku ssimu, ku tabuleeti oba ku kompyuta.
Yee. Gezaako Okugatta ebifaananyi byammwe, ekikusobozesa okulonda ebifaananyi okuva ku kyuma kyo. Ebifaananyi bisigala mu bulawuzi yo era tebitwalibwa ku mukutu.

find-the-same.name: Zuula ekifaanagana
find-the-same.seoTitle: Zuula Ekifaananyi Ekifaanagana: Omuzannyo Omwangu eri Abantu Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira
find-the-same.description: Ekifaananyi kimu waggulu, bibiri okutuuka ku bina wansi. Koonya ku ekifaanagana nakyo. Omuzannyo gw'ebifaananyi ogukkakkamu era ogwa bwereere eri abantu ababeera n'obulwadde bw'okwerabira, nga tewali ssaawa.
find-the-same.short: Tunuulira ekifaananyi ekiri waggulu era okoonye ku ekifaanagana nakyo wansi.
find-the-same.intro: Ekifaananyi kimu kiba waggulu ku lutimbe. Wansi waakyo wabaawo ebifaananyi bibiri, bisatu oba bina. Koonya ku ekifaanagana nakyo. Kiba kironda kimu ekinyangu buli mulundi, nga mulina ekifo ekimala okwogeramu.
howTo: Londa ebifaananyi bibiri, bisatu oba bina by'oyagala okulondamu. Bibiri bye byangu ennyo.
Mutunuulire ekifaananyi ekiri waggulu wamu.
Koonya ku kifaananyi ekifaanagana nakyo wansi. Kiteekebwako akabonero akalaga nti kituufu n'ebigambo ebiwombeefu bitono.
Ekifaananyi ekirala bwe kikoonyeebwa, omuzannyo gwogera linnya lyakyo bugwi era gulinda. Mutwale akaseera kammwe.
Koonya ku "Ekifaananyi ekiddako" bwe mwetegeka okulaba ekirala.
tips: Mwogere ku buli kifaananyi nga temunnalonda: langi zaakyo, engeri gye kifaananamu, n'awa we muyinza okukiraba.
Okulonda kubiri si "kwangu nnyo". Ekigendererwa kwe kuba n'akaseera akawoomu, si kusoomoozagana.
Okukoonya bwe kuba kuzibu, omuntu ayinza okulaga n'engalo naawe n'okoonya ku lulwe.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa, bubonero, kubala ntambula oba kuwangulwa. Osobola okuyimirira ekiseera kyonna, era okuyimirira wakati kiba ngeri nnungi ey'okumaliriza.

faq.q: Kibaawo ki ekifaananyi ekitali kituufu bwe kikoonyeebwa?
faq.a: Tewali kibi kibaawo. Tewali ddoboozi erikanga, musaalaba gumyufu oba kukankana. Omuzannyo gwogera linnya ly'ekifaananyi ekikoonyeeddwa era gulinda okukoonya okuddako.

faq.q: Gwa bwereere, era nneetaaga okuwandiika erinnya lyange?
faq.a: Yee, gwa bwereere, era tewali akawunti, kuwandiika linnya oba kuwanuula. Gukolera mu bulawuzi y'omukutu ku ssimu, ku tabuleeti oba ku kompyuta.

shadow-match.name: Okugatta ekisiikirize
shadow-match.seoTitle: Omuzannyo gw'Okugatta Ekisiikirize eri Abantu Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira: Ku Mukutu gwa Bwereere
shadow-match.description: Ekisiikirize ekiddugavu waggulu, ebifaananyi bibiri okutuuka ku bina wansi. Koonya ku kifaananyi ekireeta ekisiikirize ekyo. Omuzannyo ogw'okugatta ebisiikirize ogwa bwereere era omukkakkamu eri obulwadde bw'okwerabira, nga tewali ssaawa.
shadow-match.short: Tunuulira ekisiikirize era okoonye ku kifaananyi ekikireeta.
shadow-match.intro: Okugatta ebisiikirize mulimu ogumanyiddwa okuva ku lupapula olukubiddwa, wano nga guliko ebifaananyi ebinene era nga tewali kya kukuba. Ekisiikirize ekiwombeefu kiba waggulu ku lutimbe, ate ebifaananyi bibiri, bisatu oba bina birinda wansi. Koonya ku ekireeta ekisiikirize ekyo. Ebintu nga ggaali, muggalo oba ekikopo ky'ecaayi byangu okwogerako.
howTo: Londa ebifaananyi bibiri, bisatu oba bina by'oyagala okulondamu. Bibiri bye byangu ennyo.
Mutunuulire ekisiikirize wamu. Kifaanana kitya? Kiwanvu oba kya nvuumu?
Koonya ku kifaananyi ekireeta ekisiikirize ekyo. Erinnya lyakyo lirabika wansi w'ekisiikirize.
Ekifaananyi ekirala bwe kikoonyeebwa, omuzannyo gwogera linnya lyakyo bugwi era gulinda. Mutwale akaseera kammwe.
Koonya ku "Ekisiikirize ekiddako" bwe mwetegeka okulaba ekirala.
tips: Goberera ensalosalo y'ekisiikirize n'olugalo era mwogere ku ngeri gye kifaananamu.
Ebisiikirize bwe biwulira nga bizibu leero, kyusa ogende ku Zuula ekifaanagana, awa ebifaananyi we bifaanagana.
Mwogere ku kifaananyi nga kimaze okuzuulibwa: "Twalina muggalo ng'ogwo."

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa, bubonero, kubala ntambula oba kuwangulwa. Osobola okuyimirira ekiseera kyonna, era okuyimirira wakati kiba ngeri nnungi ey'okumaliriza.

faq.q: Okukwataganya ebisikirize kulungi eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira?
faq.a: Kiyinza okuba eky'okukola ekisanyusa era ekyangu eri abantu abamu, naddala mu biseera eby'olubereberye. Ebibumbidwa byangu okutegeera okusinga ebigambo. Kiriwo lwa kusanyuka na kunyumyako, si kigezo, era tekijjanjaala wadde okukendeeza ku bulwadde bw'okwerabira. Singa kireeta embeera ey'okusoberwa, gezaako Onoonye ekifaanagana oba mutunule ku bifaananyi mwenna awamu.

faq.q: Kiki ekibaawo ssinga okoona ku kifaananyi ekitakwatagana?
faq.a: Tewali kintu kibi kibawo. Tewali ddoboozi litiisa, musalaba mumyufu wadde okukankana. Omuzannyo gwatula erinnya ly'ekifaananyi ekikooneddwako era ne gulindirira okukoona okulala.
Yee, kya bwereere, era tewali kwetaagisa akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuteeka kintu ku ssimu oba kompyuta. Kikola bulungi mu mukutu gw'okubaza ku ssimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta.

sort-together.name: Sengeka awamu
sort-together.seoTitle: Omuzannyo gw'Okusengeka eri Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira: Sengeka Awamu
sort-together.description: Koona ku kifaananyi, oluvannyuma okoone ku kibbo mwe kisaana okuba: mu ffumbiro oba mu lusuku, ebibala oba ebisolo. Eky'okukola eky'okusengeka ekiteefu era eky'ebwereere eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira.
sort-together.short: Teeka buli kifaananyi mu kibbo kyakyo: effumbiro oba olusuku, n'ebirala.
sort-together.intro: Okusengeka mulimu gwa bulijjo ogumanyiddwa era oguleeta essanyu, gamba ng'okutereka ebintu ebiguliddwa oba okugatta sitokingizi ezifaanagana. Koona ku kifaananyi, oluvannyuma okoone ku kibbo we kisaana okuba. Tewali kwanguyiriza era tewali nsobi.
howTo: Londa omulamwa: effumbiro n'olusuku, ebibala n'ebisolo, oba eka n'olugendo.
Koona ku kifaananyi. Kifuna olukugiro lwa zaabu.
Koona ku kibbo mwe kisaana okuba. Ekifaananyi kigenda mu kibbo ekyo.
Bwe kiba kisaana kuba mu kibbo ekirala, omuzannyo gukiraga mu ngeri ey'empisa era ne gulinda.
Buli kifaananyi bwe kimala okusengekebwa, mutunulire awamu ebyateekeddwa mu bibbo.
tips: Mu bulamu obwa bulijjo emirundi mingi tewabaawo kuddamu kukyamu. Singa omuntu agamba nti ekipompo kisaana kuba mu ffumbiro, mubuuze ensonga. Oyinza okufunamu olugero olulungi.
Kozesa ebifaananyi okutandika emboozi: "Kiki kye watereka oba kye walima mu lusuku lwo?"
Okusengeka ebintu ebya ddala, gamba ng'amagiiko n'ewuma oba amapeesa ng'ogoberera langi, kintu kirungi nnyo ekiyinza okukolebwa oluvannyuma nga temuli ku sikuliini.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa, bubonero, kubala mirundi egy'okukwatako wadde okuwangulwa. Muyinza okuyimiriza ekiseera kyonna, era n'okukomya akayingiro wakati ngeri nnungi nnyo ey'okumalirizaamu.
Abantu bangi banyumirwa okusengeka kubanga kiba kiwulirika ng'omulimu ogugasa era ogumanyiddwa. Era kiba kyangu nnyo okwogerako ku bifaananyi nga bwe mugenda mu maaso.
Yee, kya bwereere, era tewali kwetaagisa akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuteeka kintu ku ssimu oba kompyuta. Kikola bulungi mu mukutu gw'okubaza ku ssimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta.

picture-puzzle.name: Pazolo y'ebifaananyi
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Pazolo Eyangu eri Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira: Ebitundu 4 oba 9
picture-puzzle.description: Pazolo eyangu ey'oku yintaneeti eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira: ebitundu 4 oba 9 ebinene, ekifaananyi kyonna kisigala nga kirabika, era okoona ku bitundu bibiri okubikyusa ebifo.
picture-puzzle.short: Koona ku bitundu bibiri okubikyusa ebifo okutuusa ng'ekifaananyi kyonna kiweddeyo.
picture-puzzle.intro: Ekifaananyi ekisanyusa kisalibwamu ebitundu ebinene bina oba mwenda ne bitabulwa. Ekifaananyi kyonna kisigala nga kirabika okubalagirira. Koona ku kitundu kimu, oluvannyuma okoone ku kirala, era ne bikyusa ebifo. Tewali kwetaagisa kusika kitundu.
howTo: Londa ekifaananyi n'ebitundu 4 oba 9. Ebitundu ebina kitandikilo kirungi era ekyangu.
Tunuulira ekifaananyi kyonna waggulu.
Koona ku kitundu, oluvannyuma okoone mu kifo we kisaana okugenda. Ebitundu ebyo ebibiri bikyusa ebifo.
Ebitundu ebiri mu kifo ekituufu bifuna akabonero akatono akalaga nti kituufu.
Ekifaananyi bwe kimala okujjula, mukisanyukireko mwenna awamu, oluvannyuma mulonde ekirala.
tips: Okukoona ku bitundu bibiri okubikyusa ebifo kwangu nnyo okusinga okubisika eri abantu bangi.
Mwogere ku kifaananyi nga bwe kigattibwa: "Akalanga akamyufu kaali awo."
Pazolo eya ddala ey'embaawo erimu ebitundu ebinene 12 okutuuka ku 24 nakyo kintu kirungi nnyo ekiyinza okuzannyirwa ku mmeeza.

Nedda. Koona ku kitundu kimu, oluvannyuma okoone ku kirala, era ne bikyusa ebifo. Kino kyangu nnyo eri omuntu alina omukono ogukankana oba ng'akozesa sikuliini entono.
Yee, kya bwereere, era tewali kwetaagisa akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuteeka kintu ku ssimu oba kompyuta. Kikola bulungi mu mukutu gw'okubaza ku ssimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta.

finish-the-saying.name: Maliriza olugero
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Maliriza Olugero: Omuzannyo gw'Engero eri Abakadde
finish-the-saying.description: Engero ez'Olumerika ezimanyiddwa ennyo ezibulamu ekigambo ekisembayo, gamba nga "A penny saved is a penny ___". Koona ku ky'olonze oba laga enkomerero, oluvannyuma mugyogerereko.
finish-the-saying.short: Mumalirize awamu engero ezimanyiddwa, oluvannyuma muzinyumyeeko.
finish-the-saying.intro: Engero enkadde emirundi mingi zimanyibwa obulamu bwonna. Buli kaada eraga olugero olumanyiddwa ng'ekigambo ekisembayo tekiriiko, ebyokulondako bisatu, ne peesa erigamba nti "Laga enkomerero". Oluvannyuma lw'enkomerero, ekibuuzo ekiteefu kiyitawo emboozi.
howTo: Musome olugero mu ddoboozi eriwulikika mwenna awamu.
Koona ku kigambo ekirumaliriza, oba koona ku "Laga enkomerero".
Musome olugero lwonna nate era mukubaganye ebirowoozo nga mukozesa ekibuuzo ekikubiriza emboozi.
Koona ku "Olugero oluddako" nga mwetegekedde.
tips: Musome mpolampola era muwummuleko katono nga temunnatuuka ku kigambo ekisembayo. Emirundi mingi abantu bakyogerako nga tonnakimaliriza.
Omuntu bw'awaayo enkomerero ey'enjawulo, mukisanyukireko. Enkozesa z'engero ezimu zaawukana okusinziira ku ffamire oba ekitundu.
Mu kibiina, omuntu omu asoma ate abalala bonna ne bamaliriza wamu enkomerero.

faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa ebala biseera, bubonero, kubala mirundi gigendeddwamu wadde okuwangulwa. Muyinza okuyimirira akaseera konna, era n'okukoma wakati ngeri nnungi nnyo ey'okumalirizaamu.

faq.q: Bwe tulonda ekigambo ekirala kiba kitya?
faq.a: Omuzannyo gulaga enkomerero eya bulijjo ne gukwasa emboozi. Tewali bubonero, era n'okuddamu okw'enjawulo kukkirizibwa bulungi.
Yee, bwa bwereere, era tewali akaawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuteekamu pulogulaamu. Bukolera bulungi mu mukutu gwa yintaneeti ku ssimu, tabuleeti oba kompyuta.

word-search.name: Okunoonya ebigambo mu nnukuta ennene
word-search.seoTitle: Okunoonya Ebigambo mu Nnukuta Ennene ku lw'Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira, Ebikubibwa ku Lupapula
word-search.description: Omuzannyo ogw'obwereere ogw'okunoonya ebigambo mu nnukuta ennene ku lw'abakadde n'abantu abalina obulwadde obw'okwerabira. Ebigambo bitono, ennukuta nnene, era bisimbiddwa oba byebise byokka. Zannyira ku yintaneeti oba gukube ku lupapula.
word-search.short: Ennukuta nnene, ebigambo bitono, bisimbiddwa oba byebise byokka. Gukube ne ku lupapula.
word-search.intro: Akaboozi katono akalimu ennukuta ennene n'ebigambo bitonotono, byonna nga bisomebwa bwebise oba bisimbiddwa. Koona ku nnukuta y'ekigambo ey'olubereberye, oluvannyuma koona ku nnukuta yaakyo esembayo. Mwagala lupapula? Kuba omuzannyo omupya ku lupapula n'okukoona kumwe kwokka.
howTo: Londa omutwe gw'ebigambo n'obunene bw'akaboozi.
Kebera olukalala lw'ebigambo. Ebigambo bisomebwa bwebise (okuva ku kkono okudda ku ddyo) oba bisimbiddwa (okuva waggulu okudda wansi).
Koona ku nnukuta y'ekigambo ey'olubereberye, oluvannyuma koona ku nnukuta yaakyo esembayo.
Ekigambo ekizuuliddwa kitangaazibwa era ne kisalibwako ku lukalala.
Koona ku "Kuba omuzannyo guno" okuguzannyira ku lupapula n'ekkalaamu eya ppeensulo oba ekkalaamu ey'ekiraala.
tips: Songa ku kigambo ku lukalala munoonyeze wamu ennukuta yaakyo ey'olubereberye.
Ku lupapula, ekkalaamu ey'ekiraala (highlighter) yanguwa okukwata okusinga ppeensulo.
Munyumye ku bigambo ebikwatagana n'omutwe ogwo. Ebigambo by'ebibala bikutwala mu ngeri ey'obutonde mu bijjukizo by'okunoga, okufumba oba okugenda mu katale.

faq.q: Waliwo essawa ebala ebiseera oba obubonero?
faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa ebala biseera, bubonero, kubala mirundi gigendeddwamu wadde okuwangulwa. Muyinza okuyimirira akaseera konna, era n'okukoma wakati ngeri nnungi nnyo ey'okumalirizaamu.

faq.q: Nnyinza okukuba omuzannyo guno gw'ebigambo ku lupapula?
faq.a: Yee. Koona ku "Kuba omuzannyo guno" okukuba akaboozi kano mu nnukuta ennene, ng'olukalala lw'ebigambo luli wansi waako. Buli muzannyo omupya guba gwa njawulo.
Yee, gwa bwereere, era tewali akaawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuteekamu pulogulaamu. Gukolera bulungi mu mukutu gwa yintaneeti ku ssimu, tabuleeti oba kompyuta.

coloring.name: Empapula z'okusiiga langi
coloring.seoTitle: Empapula z'Okusiiga Langi ez'Abakulu Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira (Za Bwereere)
coloring.description: Empapula z'okusiiga langi ennyangu ez'abakulu ezirimu ebitundu ebinene: koona ku langi, oluvannyuma koona ku kifaananyi. Tewali kutaataaganya, tewali langi nsobi, era buli lupapula luyinza okukubibwa ku lupapula lwa bwereere.
coloring.short: Koona ku langi, oluvannyuma koona ku kitundu ky'ekifaananyi. Kuba n'empapula ku lupapula.
coloring.intro: Empapula eziriko ebifaananyi ebinene era ebyangu: ekimuli mu nsiimbi, ennyumba, ekikopo ky'ecaayi, ekiwojjolo n'eryato. Koona ku langi, oluvannyuma koona ku kitundu ky'ekifaananyi okukisiigamu langi. Tewali langi nsobi.
howTo: Londa olupapula.
Koona ku langi. Buli langi eriko erinnya lyayo erirowandiikiddwako.
Koona ku kitundu ky'ekifaananyi okukisiigamu langi eyo.
Oyinza okukikyusa akaseera konna ng'osiigamu langi endala.
Koona ku "Kuba olupapula luno" ofune olupapula olwereere lw'oyinza okusiiga n'ekkalaamu oba obuti bwa langi.
tips: Muteerewo langi bbiri zokka z'asobola okulondako mu kifo ky'okumuwa zonna omulundi gumu singa okulonda kuba nga kumukaluubirira.
Emiti gya kakkobe n'enjuba eya bbulu byonna bikkirizibwa. Ekikulu kwe kunyumirwa langi, si kutuukiriza butuufu bwabyo.
Empapula ezikubiddwa zikola bulungi n'ekkalaamu ez'ebiraala ennene oba obuti bwa langi (crayons), kubanga byangu okukwata mu ngalo.

faq.q: Waliwo essawa ebala ebiseera oba obubonero?
faq.a: Nedda. Tewali ssaawa ebala biseera, bubonero, kubala mirundi gigendeddwamu wadde okuwangulwa. Muyinza okuyimirira akaseera konna, era n'okukoma wakati ngeri nnungi nnyo ey'okumalirizaamu.

faq.q: Empapula zino ziringa ez'abaana abato ennyo?
faq.a: Twayiiya ebintu ebikkakkamu era ebyangu mu kifo ky'ebifaananyi bya katuni, n'olwekyo empapula zino zisaanira abakulu. Ebifaananyi ebinene byanguya okusiiga awatali kubifuula bya kito.
Yee, za bwereere, era tewali akaawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuteekamu pulogulaamu. Zikolera bulungi mu mukutu gwa yintaneeti ku ssimu, tabuleeti oba kompyuta.

conversation-cards.name: Kaada z'emboozi
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Ebitandika Emboozi ku lw'Abalina Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira: Kaada ez'Ebifaananyi
conversation-cards.description: Kaada eziriko ebifaananyi ezitandika emboozi mu ngeri ey'ekisa eri abantu abalina obulwadde obw'okwerabira: tewali kubuuza bibuuzo nga kigezo, tewali kuddamu kutuufu kwokka. Kozesa ku ssikirini oba kuba omugogo gwonna ku lupapula.
conversation-cards.short: Kaada ez'ebifaananyi eziriko ebibuuzo ebyangu era eby'ekisa. Tewali kubuuza kigezo.
conversation-cards.intro: Buli kaada egatta ekifaananyi ekimanyiddwa obulungi n'omukisa omwangu ogw'okunyumya, gamba nga "Mbeera ki ey'obudde gy'osinga okwagala?" Tewali kuddamu kutuufu kwokka era tewali kyetaagisa kujjukirwa. Londa omutwe gw'emboozi oba zitabulatabule zonna.
howTo: Londa omutwe gw'emboozi, oba leka ku "Kaada zonna".
Soma ekibuuzo mu ddoboozi eriwulikika mutunuulire ekifaananyi mwembi.
Wuliriza, gabanako ky'olowooza naawe, era muleke emboozi etambule bulungi.
Koona ku "Kaada eddako" nga mwetegekedde, oba musigale ku kaada emu ebbanga lyonna lye mwagala.
Koona ku "Kuba kaada zonna" osobole okusala kaada ez'olupapula.
tips: Ddamu n'ekibuuzo ekyo naawe. Kino kireetera emboozi okuwulika nga lussa lwa bantu abanyumya, si kubuuzibwa bibuuzo.
Goberera emboozi, si butuufu bwa bintu. Ebintu bwe bikyuka mu nnyumya, tewali buzibu.
Singa kaada ekwata ku kintu ekinakuwaza, tegeera enneewulira eyo era oluvannyuma mukyusizeemu mpola mugende ku kaada endala.

faq.a: Ebibuuzo ebigezesa okujjukira biyinza okuwulikika ng'ekigezo era ne biviirako okuswala. Okuyita abantu okunyumya nga "Mbulirako ebikwata ku..." kukkiriza buli muntu okwenyigiramu, kikkakkana kye yandiba ng'ajjukira.

faq.q: Nnyinza okukuba kaada zino ku lupapula?
faq.a: Yee. "Kuba kaada zonna" ekuba omugogo gwonna mu nnukuta ennene, kaada eziwerako ku buli lupapula, nga zeetegekedde okusalwako.
Yee, ya bwereere, era tewali kwetaagisa kuggulawo akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okukoppolola pulogulaamu. Ekola butereevu mu mukutu gwa yintaneeti ku ssimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta.

photo-pairs.name: Ebifaananyi eby'emigogo
photo-pairs.h1: Ebifaananyi eby'emigogo: Gatta ebifaananyi byammwe byennyini
photo-pairs.description: Fuula ebifaananyi by'amaka gammwe omuzannyo omwangu ogw'okugattagana. Londa ebifaananyi 2 okutuuka ku 6 ku kyuma kyo; bisigala mu mukutu gwo ogwa yintaneeti era tebitikkibwa ku mutimbagano.
photo-pairs.short: Londa ebifaananyi byo obigatte wamu. Tewali kitikkibwa ku mutimbagano.
photo-pairs.intro: Londa ebifaananyi bibiri okutuuka ku mukaaga okuva ku ssimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta yo, bifuuke omuzannyo ogw'okugatta ebifaananyi ebinene era ebirabika obulungi. Ebifaananyi birabikira wano wokka ku lupapula luno. Tebitikkibwa, tebiterekebwa era tebigabanibwa, era bibulawo olumala okuggalawo olupapula.
howTo: Nyiga ku "Londa ebifaananyi" olonde ebifaananyi bibiri okutuuka ku mukaaga.
Buli kifaananyi kirabika emirundi ebiri. Nyiga ku kimu, oluvannyuma onyige ku kinnaakyo ekikifaanana.
Munyumyeeko ku buli kifaananyi nga mukizudde.
Bwe mumala, ggalawo olupapula oba nyiga ku "Ggyawo ebifaananyi". Tewali kiterekebwa.
tips: Londa ebifaananyi ebirabika obulungi eby'ebintu ebisanyusa era ebimanyiddwa obulungi: ebisolo by'omuka, olusuku, ekifo ekyagalwa ennyo, oba olunaku olw'embaga.
Ebifaananyi by'ebifo n'ebintu biviiramu okuba ebyangu okusinga eby'obwenyi bw'abantu, era biteekawo eddembe awatali kuwalirizibwa kuteebereza mannya ga bantu.
Leka ebifaananyi by'abantu abaafa singa birowoozebwa nti biyinza okuleeta ennaku ey'amangwago, okuggyako nga mukakasa nti bireeta okubudaabudibwa.

faq.q: Ebifaananyi byange bitikkibwa awalala wonna ku mutimbagano?
faq.a: Nedda. Olupapula lusoma ebifaananyi by'olonze butereevu mu mukutu gwo gwa yintaneeti ne lubiraga ku sikuliini yo. Tebisindikibwa gye tuli wadde eri omuntu omulala yenna, era bibulawo ssinga oggalawo oba n'oddilamu okusoma olupapula.
Nedda. Tewali ssaawa, bubonero, kubala mirundi wadde okuwangulwa. Muyinza okuyimirira ekiseera kyonna kye mwagadde, era n'okukoma mu makkati kukkirizibwa bulungi nnyo.

faq.q: Nnyinza okutereka omuzannyo guno gunkolere omulundi oguliddako?
faq.a: Nedda mu mukutu gwa yintaneeti, kubanga kyategekebwa kityo okukuuma ebyama byo nga tewali kiterekebwa. Pulogulaamu eya bwereere eya Golden Moments ey'ebikozesebwa ebya iPhone ne iPad eyinza okutereka kkopi z'ebifaananyi ebirondeddwa ku kyuma kyo.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo y'ebifaananyi
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo y'ebifaananyi ey'abakadde abalina obuzibu bw'okwerabira: Eyinza okukubibwa ku lupapula
picture-bingo.description: Bingo y'ebifaananyi eya bwereere eyinza okukubibwa ku mpapula ey'abakadde n'abantu abalina obuzibu bw'okwerabira, erina ekiraga ebifaananyi ekinene ku sikuliini. Ebifaananyi binene nga biriko ebigambo, obusonda 9 oba 16, tewali kusoma kwetaagisa.
picture-bingo.short: Kkaadi za bingo ez'ebifaananyi ezikubibwa ku lupapula n'ekiraga ebifaananyi ku sikuliini ennene eby'ebibiina.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo ey'abulijjo ekozesa ebifaananyi mu kifo ky'ennamba, bwe kityo tewali yetaaga kusoma nnyukuta ntono. Kuba kkaadi ezitali za ngeri emu ku lupapula, oluvannyuma kozesa ekiraga ebifaananyi ku sikuliini okulaga buli kifaananyi mu bunene bwakyo ku ttivi, laaputoopu oba taabuleti.
howTo: Londa obusonda 9 oba 16 ku buli kkaadi n'omuwendo gw'abazannyi.
Nyiga ku "Kuba kkaadi ku lupapula". Buli kkaadi ya njawulo.
Ggulawo ekiraga ebifaananyi ku sikuliini ennene. Nyiga ku "Ekifaananyi ekiddako" okulaga buli kifaananyi n'erinnya lyakyo.
Abazannyi babikkako ku kifaananyi ekyenkana ku kkaadi yaabwe nga bakozesa ekinusu, eppeesa oba akabonero konna.
Buli azuula olunyiriri olujjuvu, oba kkaadi yonna, akubirwa empi. Tewali awangulwa mu nteekateeka eno: mugende mu maaso n'okuzannya okutuusa nga buli omu afunye olunyiriri.
tips: Kozesa obubonero obunene nga bukkapu oba ebisaanikira by'eccupa. Amapeesa amatono gayinza okuzibuwalira abamu okukwata.
Yatuuma ekifaananyi era oyogereko ekintu ekikwata ku kyo: "Eryato ery'empewo. Ani eyali atambuliddeko mu lyato?"
Tuuza abantu abalina obuzibu mu kulaba okumpi ennyo ne sikuliini, era gatta abayambi n'abazannyi abeetaaga obuyambi.
Obusonda omwenda bumala bulungi mu bibiina ebisinga obungi. Ekiseera ky'omuzannyo kibeere wakati w'eddakiika 20 ne 30.

faq.q: Nnyinza ntya okukulembera bingo y'ebifaananyi mu maka g'abakadde n'abalabirirwa?
faq.a: Kuba kkaadi emu ku buli muzannyi ku lupapula, teeka ekiraga ebifaananyi ku sikuliini esinga obunene gye mulina, era oyatuume ebifaananyi mpola mpola, ng'oyita buli kimu erinnya lyakyo. Muzannye okutuusa nga buli omu afunye olunyiriri, waleme kubaawo alemwa oba asigalira emmabega.
Yee. Kuba kkaadi zonna ze mwetaaga ku lupapula, emirundi gyonna gye mwagadde, ku lwammwe oba ng'ekibiina.

faq.q: Abantu bayinza okuzannya nga tebasaanye kusoma?
faq.a: Yee. Buli kasonda kaliko ekifaananyi ekinene, ng'erinnya lyakyo liri wansi waakyo eri abo abaagala ebigambo.

calm-breathing.name: Okwissa mu mirembe
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Akafo k'okuwummulamu n'okwissa mu mirembe eri abakadde n'ababalabirira
calm-breathing.description: Okuwummulamu okw'akaboozi akasaale mu kussa: enkulungo empolempole egejja n'ekendeeva okumala emikka mukaaga. Mugitandika mmwe, era muyinza okugiyimiriza ekiseera kyonna.
calm-breathing.short: Enkulungo empolempole gye mwissizaako. Gitandike era ogiyimirize nga bw'oyagala.
calm-breathing.intro: Oluusi ekintu ekisinga obulungi kwe kuba n'akaseera ak'okuwummulamu mu kasirise. Nyiga ku "Tandika", oluvannyuma osse omukka ng'enkulungo eno egejja era ogufulumye ng'ekendeeva. Londa emisinde empola oba amangwago. Guno si musawo wadde obujjanjabi, kaseera ka ddembe na kukkakkana ka kugabanira wamu.
howTo: Mutuule obulungi nga mutudde wamu.
Mwerondere emisinde: empola oba ey'akaboozi akasaale.
Nyiga ku "Tandika". Ssa omukka munda ng'enkulungo egejja, era ogufulumye ng'ekendeeva.
Eyimirira yokka oluvannyuma lw'emikka mukaaga, oba nyiga ku "Yimiriza" ekiseera kyonna kye mwagadde.
tips: Mukwatagane mu ngalo oba teeka omukono gwo ku mukono gw'omuntu gw'olabirira singa aba akiwulira bulungi.
Temukaka muntu n'akamu. Singa baagala kutunulako butunuzi, ekyo kiba kirungi nnyo.
Singa omuntu aba n'obuzibu mu kussa, assenga bulijjo era atunuulire obutunuulizi enkulungo eno. Buuza omusawo ku nsonga zonna ezikwata ku kussa.

faq.a: Nedda. Kaseera kangu era ak'okwerondera ak'okukkakkana n'okubeerako wamu. Si bujjanjabi bwa kweraliikirira wadde obulwadde obulala bwonna. Tegeezezzaako omusawo ku nsonga zonna ez'obulamu.

faq.q: Enkulungo eno etambula nga nze ssi gitandise?
faq.a: Nedda. Tewali kintu kyonna ekitambula okutuusa lw’onyiga Okutandika, era kiyimirira oluvannyuma lw’okussa emirundi mukaaga oba lw’onyiga Okulekera awo. Singa ekyuma kyo kitegekeddwa okukendeeza ku ntambula, ebigambo bikyuka nga enkulungo teyeeyongera bunene.
Yee, kya bwereere, era tekyetaagisa akawunti, kwewandiisa wadde okuwanula. Kikola mu mutimbagano gw’omu ssimu, tabuleeti oba kompyuta.
